Warren County Fiscal Court
Meeting Minutes
March 26, 2026
Pursuant to adjournment, Warren Fiscal Court met on Thursday, March 26, 2026
at 9:00 AM in the Warren County Fiscal Courtroom at 429 E 10th Avenue, Bowling
Green, Kentucky. Present were: Esquire Eric Aldridge, Esquire Ron Cummings,
Esquire Scott Lasley, Esquire Tom Lawrence, and Esquire Rex McWhorter, and
Esquire Rick Williams.
**********
Due to Judge Gorman’s absence and in accordance with KRS 67.040(2), Esquire
Aldridge moved, seconded by Esquire Cummings to elect Esquire Lawrence to
preside over the meeting. Upon roll call the vote was: five yeas, no nays. It is so
ordered.
**********
Invocation by Esquire Ron Cummings.
**********
Esquire Williams led the pledge to the flag.
**********
Esquire McWhorter moved, seconded by Esquire Aldridge to approve minutes of
the Fiscal Court meeting on March 12, 2026. Upon roll call the vote was: six yeas, no
nays. It is so ordered. (4)
**********
Esquire Lawrence moved, seconded by Esquire Aldridge to approve personnel
changes for Warren County. Upon roll call the vote was: six yeas, no nays. It is so
ordered. (5)
**********
Esquire McWhorter moved, seconded by Esquire Cummings to approve work
schedule for the Warren County Road Department. Upon roll call the vote was: six
yeas, no nays. It is so ordered. (6)
**********
Parks Department recognized Joseph Gott on his upcoming Retirement.
**********
Esquire Cummings moved, seconded by Esquire McWhorter to exoneration for
IGPS Logistics in the amount of $1,158.70 for the Warren County Sheriff’s
Department. Upon roll call the vote was: six yeas, no nays. It is so ordered. (See
Fiscal Court Order Book 21, Supp. 240, 528-A). (7)
**********
Esquire Lasley moved, seconded by Esquire Williams to approve determination in
the amount of $18,355 to Heritage Fire Equipment for the purchase of two (2) skid
units for side-by-sides for the Technical Rescue Team. (Single source vendor). Upon
roll call the vote was: six yeas, no nays. It is so ordered. (8)
**********
Esquire Aldridge moved, seconded by Esquire Cummings to approve determination
in the amount of $11,250 to Travis Bell, Swiftwater Rescue Specialist, for a 3-day
training course for the Technical Rescue Team. (Single source vendor). Upon roll
call the vote was: six yeas, no nays. It is so ordered. (9)
**********
Esquire Lasley moved, seconded by Esquire Williams to accept bid in the amount of
$41,800 to SkyCop for a surveillance trailer for Emergency Management. (Bid was
publicly advertised. Three bids were received. This is the best evaluated bid.). Upon
roll call the vote was: six yeas, no nays. It is so ordered. (10)
**********
Esquire Aldridge moved, seconded by Esquire McWhorter to approve
determination in the amount of $14,353.40 to Motorola Solutions for portable radios
for Warren County Fire Department System. (Single Source Vendor). Upon roll call
the vote was: six yeas, no nays. It is so ordered. (11)
**********
Esquire Aldridge moved, seconded by Esquire Cummings to approve determination
in the amount of $12,906 to Water Dog for 12 dry suits for the Technical Rescue
Team. (Three quotes solicited; two were obtained. This was the lowest and best.).
Upon roll call the vote was: six yeas, no nays. It is so ordered. (12)
**********
Esquire Aldridge moved, seconded by Esquire Cummings to authorize Judge
Executive to execute renewal agreement for the HB556 inmate funding program for
FY 2027 and 2028. Upon roll call the vote was: six yeas, no nays. It is so ordered.
(See Fiscal Court Order Book 21, Supp. 240, 529-A). (13)
**********
Esquire Lasley moved, seconded by Esquire Williams to approve Kentucky Pride
Fund Recycling Grant Application with the Kentucky Department of
Environmental Protection Division of Waste Management and authorize Judge
Executive to execute all related documents. Upon roll call the vote was: six yeas, no
nays. It is so ordered. (See Fiscal Court Order Book 21, Supp. 240, 529-B-2). (14)
**********
Esquire Aldridge moved, seconded by Esquire Cummings to approve determination
in the amount of $80,010 to 911 Fleet and Fire Equipment for Personal Protective
Equipment (PPE) for 18 firefighters employed by the Warren County Fire
Department System. (KCTCS Contract Pricing). Upon roll call the vote was: six
yeas, no nays. It is so ordered. (15)
**********
Esquire Cummings moved, seconded by Esquire Aldridge to accept cost increase
from Fouts Fire Service in the amount of $26,043.15 each for (2) Spartan Chassis
Custom Cab Structural Fire Engines. (Previously approved in the amount of
$1,596,482 on December 18, 2025. These changes reflect several operational and
maintenance improvements from the original specification. New total cost for both
engines is $1,648,568.30.). Upon roll call the vote was: six yeas, no nays. It is so
ordered. (See Fiscal Court Order Book 21, Supp. 240, 530-A). (16)
**********
Esquire McWhorter moved, seconded by Esquire Aldridge to approve
determination in the amount of $6,662 to PennCare for the purchase of two (2)
Physio-Control LifePak AEDs for Warren County Fire Department System
response vehicles. (Three quotes obtained. This is the lowest and best.) Upon roll
call the vote was: six yeas, no nays. It is so ordered. (17)
**********
Esquire Cummings moved, seconded by Esquire McWhorter to approve contract
with The SpyGlass Group to review Warren County technology contracts for
potential cost savings and authorize Judge Executive to execute all related
documents. (This review is at no cost to Warren County. Savings options discovered
can be utilized for a fee, if desired.). Upon roll call the vote was: six yeas, no nays. It
is so ordered. (See Fiscal Court Order Book 21, Supp. 240, 530-B). (18)
**********
Esquire Lasley moved, seconded by Esquire Aldridge to approve Treasurer’s
Report for February 2026. Upon roll call the vote was: six yeas, no nays. It is so
ordered. (19)
**********
Esquire Lasley moved, seconded by Esquire Aldridge to approve Warren County
Regional Jail Canteen Account Financial Report for February 2026. Upon roll call
the vote was: six yeas, no nays. It is so ordered. (20)
**********
Esquire Lasley moved, seconded by Esquire Williams to authorize Judge Executive
to sign the Justice Assistance Grant (JAG) Memorandum of Understanding and
Certification documents for a $34,484 grant that will be split between the city and
county. Upon roll call the vote was: six yeas, no nays. It is so ordered. (See Fiscal
Court Order Book 21, Supp. 240, 530-C). (21)
**********
Esquire Aldridge moved, seconded by Esquire Cummings to approve determination
in the amount of $41,082 to Freedom Dodge in Lexington for a 2026 Dodge Durango
for Drug Taskforce. (State Price Contract. Paid for with funds from the DTF
auction at no cost to Warren County). Upon roll call the vote was: six yeas, no nays.
It is so ordered. (22)
**********
Esquire Aldridge moved, seconded by Esquire Cummings to accept lowest and best
bid from Tomco, Inc dba Rental City for SOKY Ice Rink Stage Platform system in
the amount of $202,770.60. (This was publicly advertised with two bids received.).
Upon roll call the vote was: six yeas, no nays. It is so ordered. (23)
**********
Esquire Lasley moved, seconded by Esquire Williams to approve contract
agreement with KG-STORM, the City of Bowling Green, and Western Kentucky
University in an amount not to exceed $96,672 per year for five years, $472,221
total. (Paid by Warren County Stormwater). Upon roll call the vote was: six yeas, no
nays. It is so ordered. (See Fiscal Court Order Book 21, Supp. 240, 531-A). (24)
**********
Esquire Aldridge moved, seconded by Esquire Cummings to approve determination
in the amount of $152,780.00 to IRE Crown Rinks, LLC for SoKY Ice Rink
installation/removal for 2026-2027 season. (This is the final year of the three-year
agreement with the contracted vendor.). Upon roll call the vote was: six yeas, no
nays. It is so ordered. (25)
**********
Esquire Aldridge moved, seconded by Esquire Cummings to authorize Warren
County Jailer to sign 1-year contract extension with Comprehensive Correctional
Care for inmate medical services in the amount of $2,167,730.75. Upon roll call the
vote was: six yeas, no nays. It is so ordered. (26)
**********
Esquire Aldridge moved, seconded by Esquire Williams to approve fiscal year 2026-
2027 budget for the Warren County Regional Jail. Upon roll call the vote was: six
yeas, no nays. It is so ordered. (27)
**********
Esquire McWhorter moved, seconded by Esquire Aldridge to approve Order #26-12
Declaring Surplus Equipment for Parks and Rec. Upon roll call the vote was: six
yeas, no nays. It is so ordered. (See Fiscal Court Order Book 21, Supp. 240, 531-B).
(28)
**********
Esquire Lasley moved, seconded by Esquire Williams to approve budget transfers
for Warren County. Upon roll call the vote was: six yeas, no nays. It is so ordered.
(29)
**********
Esquire Williams moved, seconded by Esquire Lasley to approve 24-month Facility
Usage Agreement with Warren County Public Library for use of satellite location at
Buchanon Park Tennis Facility as well as other various programs. Upon roll call the
vote was: six yeas, no nays. It is so ordered. (See Fiscal Court Order Book 21, Supp.
240, 531-C-3). (30)
**********
Esquire Cummings moved, seconded by Esquire Aldridge to approve Fiscal Year
26-27 Rental Fee schedule for Parks and Rec effective July 1, 2026. Upon roll call
the vote was: six yeas, no nays. It is so ordered. (31)
**********
Esquire Aldridge moved, seconded by Esquire Lasley to accept lowest and best bid
from Scotty’s Contracting & Stone for Site Improvements at 1019, 1023, and 1029
State Street in the amount of $74,678.64. (Publicly advertised with five bids
received). Upon roll call the vote was: six yeas, no nays. It is so ordered. (32)
**********
Esquire Aldridge moved, seconded by Esquire McWhorter to accept lowest and best
bid from DDWF1, LLC for County Wide Right of Way Mowing in the amount of
$469,393.25. (Single responsive bid). Upon roll call the vote was: six yeas, no nays. It
is so ordered. (33)
**********
Esquire Lasley moved, seconded by Esquire Aldridge to accept lowest and best bid
from Affordable Lawn Care for Corridor and Basin Mowing in the amount of
$48,101.50. (Publicly advertised with two bids received.). Upon roll call the vote
was: six yeas, no nays. It is so ordered. (34)
**********
Magistrates present were given a copy of claims to be paid and after examination of
all claims the following motion was made: Esquire Cummings moved seconded by
Esquire Aldridge to approve claims as submitted. Upon roll call the vote was: six
yeas, no nays. It is so ordered. (35)
**********
Esquire Lawrence moved, seconded by Esquire Aldridge that court adjourn to meet
again on Thursday, April 16, 2026 at 9:00 AM. It is so ordered.
______________________________________
DOUGLAS J. GORMAN
WARREN COUNTY JUDGE EXECUTIVE
